about: Minecraft World Wiki 是一部以 Minecraft 世界為基礎、與現實世界平行的世界觀百科，記錄這個世界的國家、城鎮、交通、組織、宗教與歷史。
條目由世界觀作者撰寫並審核後發布。藍色連結為已發布的條目；紅色文字表示該條目已經寫好、正在審核中，尚未公開。
本站提供繁體中文與英文兩種語言，可用每一頁右上角的「語言」選單切換。英文版由中文條目翻譯而來，尚未翻譯的條目在語言選單中會顯示為灰色。
footer: Minecraft World Wiki・平行世界的自由百科

en.tagline: An encyclopedia of a world built in Minecraft that runs parallel to our own
en.map_caption: World map and spheres of influence (version of 30 August 2026).
did_you_know: that the [[神武鐵路|Jinmu Railway]] has more stations and crosses more countries than any other line on the route map?
that the [[探索者線|Explorer Line]] is the only railway that reaches Srebro?
that the [[卡諾共和國|Republic of Canal]] is the only city-state in the world today with a complete city wall?
that construction of the [[-30高速鐵路|-30 High Speed Railway]] was halted because excavation proved too difficult and too expensive?
about: Minecraft World Wiki is an encyclopedia of a world built in Minecraft that runs parallel to our own. It records the world's countries, towns, transport, organizations, religions and history.
Articles are written and reviewed by the world's author before they are published. Blue links lead to published articles; red text marks an article that has been written but is still under review.

The wiki is available in Traditional Chinese and English. Use the Language menu at the top right of every page to switch. English articles are translated from the Chinese originals; links marked “zh” lead to articles that are not yet available in English.
en.footer: Minecraft World Wiki · The free encyclopedia of a parallel world
